personality_one_liner: Command-center sports utility with high contrast metrics, instant tracking, and vibrant green-yellow team kits.

spacing.rule: Clean operational rhythm with comfortable 56pt touch targets and compact metric gaps

do's: Keep high clarity and contrast for live game tracking
Use solid dark tactical surfaces for high-intensity readability
dont's: Avoid heavy blurs that impair rapid stat scanning

screens.name: Convocatoria
screens.purpose: Configure upcoming match details and track player RSVP attendance (Voy/No voy).

states.loading: Centered sports spinner with pitch branding
states.empty: Empty state prompting squad setup in Administration
states.error: Alert banner with retry action for local storage sync

screens.layout: Match configuration card at top with date, time, and venue picker. Live attendance counter badge. Scrollable roster list with green 'Voy' and red 'No voy' toggle buttons for each player.

screens.name: Partido de la Semana
screens.purpose: Manage live team allocation (Equipo Verde vs Equipo Amarillo), scoreboard, MVP selection, and match stats.

states.loading: Loading team rosters and live score state
states.empty: Prompt to confirm attendance in Convocatoria before assigning teams
states.error: Notification of save conflict with manual override button

screens.layout: Team assignment split cards for Verde and Amarillo. Real-time scoreboard with increment buttons. Player stat logger for goals and assists. Finalize match button with MVP dropdown selector.

screens.name: Clasificación Individual
screens.purpose: Display standings ordered by victory points with full individual statistics.

states.empty: No completed matches recorded yet. Finish a match to populate rankings.
states.error: Error reading local storage standings cache

screens.layout: Sticky header ranking table with columns for Posición, Nombre, Puntos, PJ, Goles, Asistencias, and MVP Trophies. Top 3 highlighted with special rank badges.

screens.name: Administración
screens.purpose: Add new players to the roster and manage season resets.

states.empty: No players added yet. Use the form below to add your first player.
states.error: Validation error for player data entry

screens.layout: Quick player registration form with inputs for Name, Jersey Number (Dorsal), and Futsal Position (Portero, Cierre, Ala, Pívot). Active player roster management list with delete/edit actions. Season reset action card at the bottom.

futsal_pitch_hero.alt: Indoor futsal court with ball and pitch markings

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure absolute adherence to dark-first utility styling. Use local storage for all data persistence. Implement green and yellow team kits for match allocation. Support RSVP convocation, team balancing, scoreboard, MVP selection, individual standings, player administration, and season resets preserving roster definitions.
